description: Source code for radio MAC configuration management, including MAC address generation, shifting, and synchronization for wireless radios, with functions for handling MAC address offsets, BSSID, EP MAC, and MAC configuration updates.

methods.name: s_useMultiBssidMask
methods.description: Determines if multi BSSID mask should be used based on operating frequency band (specifically for 6GHz band).

methods.name: s_getNrReqBss
methods.description: Calculates the number of required BSSs for a radio, considering BSSID shifts and mapped APs.

methods.name: s_getNrCfgBss
methods.description: Returns the configured maximum number of BSSs, limited by requirements and hardware limits.

methods.name: s_getMacOffset
methods.description: Calculates MAC address offset based on previous radio and guest configuration.

methods.name: wld_rad_macCfg_hasShiftedMbssBaseMac
methods.description: Checks if the radio's MAC address has been shifted for multi-BSSID configuration.

methods.name: s_getRoundedPow2
methods.description: Rounds a number up to the next power of two.

methods.name: s_getNrCfgBssRoundedPow2
methods.description: Returns the rounded power of two for the configured BSS count.

methods.name: s_getNrSuppBss
methods.description: Calculates the supported number of BSSs, considering MBSID mask and mapped APs.

methods.name: wld_rad_macCfg_shiftMbssIfNotEnoughVaps
methods.description: Shifts the MBSS base MAC address if there are not enough MACs for secondary BSSs.

methods.name: wld_rad_macCfg_updateRadBaseMac
methods.description: Updates the radio's base MAC address considering configuration and previous radio state.

methods.name: wld_rad_macCfg_generateEpMac
methods.description: Generates an MAC address for an endpoint based on radio MAC and rank.

methods.name: wld_rad_macCfg_generateBssid
methods.description: Generates a BSSID MAC address based on radio MAC, BSS index, and configuration.

methods.name: wld_rad_macCfg_generateDummyBssid
methods.description: Generates a dummy BSSID MAC address for local or test interfaces.

methods.name: s_setMACConfig_ocf
methods.description: Callback to set MAC configuration parameters from external object.
